name: zmath_build_perspective_texture_interpolants
description: zMath_BuildPerspectiveTextureInterpolants builds perspective-correct 1/z, u/z, and v/z interpolation planes for one textured triangle, including the original degenerate fallback outputs.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?zMath_BuildPerspectiveTextureInterpolants@@YIXPBUzVec3@@PBUzVec2@@PAU2@PAM2323@Z at 0x4753e0 still fails with 865 unmasked mismatches after 76 relocation-masked bytes and 12 trailing VC NOPs; BN size is 978 bytes and VC5 object symbol size is 816 bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4753e0 validates the three camera-space vertex deltas, cross-product plane setup, g_zMath_InvProjScaleX/Y scaling, reciprocal-depth output writes, u/z and v/z output writes, and zero/1000.0f fallback paths for degenerate geometry.
The native smoke verifies the expected interpolation planes for a simple right triangle and the degenerate fallback values.
